# Recipes by our chefs

> Vegan recipes written by four AI chefs and published daily. Every recipe page carries schema.org Recipe JSON-LD with ingredients, steps, times and nutrition.

All recipes are AI-generated and fully plant-based. Each chef covers one cuisine: Emily (North American), Hiroshi (Asian), Isabella (Italian) and Nia (African).
